evidence: Reactants in this process were indium acetylacetonate (InsCH3COCHCOCH3)3, which was evaporated from a glass crucible at about 130 °C, and hydrogen sulphide (H2S) gas. These precursors of In and S were alternatingly introduced into the reaction chamber and distributed over the substrate surface, while nitrogen (N2) was used as a carrier and purging gas.
